feed.title: Verilay Patchmap: Desktop and apps on Windows 11 26H2
feed.subtitle: Known problems and monthly security updates for Windows, from Verilay Patchmap. Not affiliated with Microsoft.

entry.title: Now fixed: USB audio devices might fail to start or produce no sound
entry.summary: Fixed in KB5132061. Affects: Windows 11 26H2. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/release-health/status-windows-11-26h2#4984msgdesc. From Microsoft release health.

entry.title: Windows 11 26H2: Desktop and apps in the November 2026 update (81 fixes)
entry.summary: KB5132043, KB5132061, KB5135385: 81 security fixes in Desktop and apps. Biggest parts: Windows Audio Service (8); Windows Broadcast DVR User Service (8); Microsoft WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL (5); Windows Shell (4).

entry.title: Now fixed: Applications which require AC-3 audio decoding might close unexpectedly
entry.summary: Started with KB5124010. Fixed in KB5127648. Affects: Windows 11 26H2. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/release-health/resolved-issues-windows-11-26h2#3781msgdesc. From Microsoft release health.

entry.title: Windows 11 26H2: Desktop and apps in the October 2026 update (151 fixes)
entry.summary: KB5127648: 151 security fixes in Desktop and apps. Biggest parts: Microsoft Windows Search Component (29); Windows Broadcast DVR User Service (20); Windows Device Association Service (11); Microsoft Windows Media Foundation (9).
